bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
docker exec debug-ai-debug-ai-1 node -e 'const {createAiCoreAdapter}=require("/app/server/adapters/ai-core.js");const e=process.env;const map={coder:e.DEBUG_AI_CORE_GATE_CODER_URL,qwen3:e.DEBUG_AI_CORE_GATE_QWEN3_URL,granite:e.DEBUG_AI_CORE_GATE_GRANITE_URL,ministral:e.DEBUG_AI_CORE_GATE_MINISTRAL_URL};const a=createAiCoreAdapter({baseUrl:e.DEBUG_AI_CORE_URL,apiKey:e.AI_CORE_API_KEY,modelGateBaseUrls:map,dispatchMode:"model_gates"});(async()=>{for(const [i,role] of ["code_scout","causal_scout","researcher","local_reviewer"].entries()){try{await a.preflightRoleGate(role,{probeTimeoutMs:4000})}catch(err){const code=String(err.code||"");process.exit((code==="AI_CORE_GATE_UNREACHABLE"||code==="AI_CORE_GATE_PREFLIGHT_TIMEOUT"?20:code==="AI_CORE_GATE_HTTP"?30:code==="AI_CORE_GATE_MODEL_MISMATCH"?40:50)+i)}}process.exit(0)})().catch(()=>process.exit(69))'
